proposals.evidence: DEDR1120 gives Tamil kaṭalai, Malayalam kaṭala, Kannada kaḍale and related southern gram names. The survey kadala/kadale groundnut responses are a modern extension of that pulse noun; preserve groundnut rather than relabelling the referent Bengal gram. Homepage comparison also attests Kannada kaḍalekāyi groundnut under this family, but no ancient Dravidian word for the introduced crop is claimed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1578 gives Tamil kiẓaṅku esculent/bulbous root, explicitly including potato, and Kannada geṇasu/geẓasu, Tulu kereṅg- and related tuber names. These bare survey kaŋgɨ/kalaŋgɨ/gelusum/ghāśu potato responses compare with that root/tuber family. Botanical application to potato is retained, without equating potato and yam as species. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Survey Irula kusu, Badaga kūśu and Sholaga kōcu child compare with the Nilgiri/southern infant noun; the questioned Gondi aunt comparison is not used. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
